answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 39019 Country: Bangladesh Title: I want lots of children (boys) and also Allah make them Alim. That is my own demand from Allah Question: I want lots of children (boys) and also Allah make them Alim. That is my own demand from Allah. Is this prayer (dua) correct? Answer ID: 39019 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1095/918/B=1433) Yes, your dua is correct. May Almighty Allah accept your dua and fulfil your desire and ambition! Amen! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
